listingTitle: Let any and all short-circuit generators
title: Let any and all short-circuit generators
why: A list comprehension evaluates every item and allocates the complete result before any or all can inspect it, preventing short-circuiting.
suggestion: Pass a generator expression directly to any or all instead of constructing an intermediate list.
limitations: Only direct single-line or multiline list comprehensions passed to unqualified calls named any or all are reported; comprehensions containing await are excluded because a generator replacement would be asynchronous.
Shadowing of the Python built-ins and unreviewed side effects are not inferred; adjacent comments explicitly requiring every operation to run or disabling short-circuiting are accepted.
